flash|celestial.synergy: Blinds a target to impose banes on its attacks and strip sight-based abilities; scales to a full minute of blind on a high roll.

fleeting life|life.synergy: Keeps a fallen ally with 10 HP active for 8 hours; sacrifice ability converts it to moderate healing when animation isn't needed.

flense|air.synergy: Execute finisher that instakills incapacitated targets; pair with Health-reduction debuffs to trigger the threshold on tougher foes.

flesh-bursting curse|curse.synergy: +4d6 per hit after cursing scales with attack frequency; best paired with multiattack allies or spells that deal auto-damage repeatedly.

flicker|chaos.synergy: Passive repositioning each round lets melee-casters cycle between threat ranges without spending actions on movement.

fling|air.synergy: Prone + forced displacement separates melee threats from allies or slams enemies into walls for collision damage.

flood|water.synergy: Displaces mobs up to 4d6 yards into hazards or off ledges; clears magical flames rank 3 and below, doubling as situational anti-magic field control.

flowing form|transformation.synergy: Pass through enemy lines to reach backline casters or escape encirclement; low-rank and broadly useful for any mobile melee build.

flying blades|technomancy.synergy: Stack all five blades on one low-defense target for up to 10d6 burst, or fan out to strip HP from multiple weak enemies in one action.

flying disc|arcana.synergy: Move yourself or cargo 20 yards vertically or laterally as a triggered action each turn, preserving your main action for offense or spells.

flying knives|conjuration.synergy: Move the zone with a triggered action to chase enemies; pair with control effects to prevent fleeing.

focused light|celestial.synergy: Repositionable concentration beam hits each round along a new line; effective against slow-moving or clustered enemies.

focused strike|soul.synergy: Lets Will-based Soul casters strike at full stat in melee with a boon, enabling spellsword builds with zero Strength investment.

fog|storm.synergy: Blocks line-of-sight for ranged attackers and masks ally movement; pairs with abilities that exploit partial concealment.

fold space|chaos.synergy: Triggered version costs only a triggered action, freeing the main action to attack immediately after repositioning.

forbidden knowledge|madness.synergy: Trade Insanity for 2-boon rolls on every action; combine with Serenity to prevent fear from negating the Insanity gain.

forbidden zone|order.synergy: Zone denial with 4d6 entry punishment; pair with pushback spells to repeatedly drive enemies through the barrier.

forbid|enchantment.synergy: Forbid the enemy's primary action; 3 banes + daze on failure locks high-value targets out of their main contribution for multiple rounds.

force field|protection.synergy: Absorbs up to 10 damage before breaking; best on casters or duelists who need one extra hit's worth of buffer.

force missile|telekinesis.synergy: Push + prone combos with melee allies (boon to attack prone targets) or repositions enemies into hazards.

force shield|protection.synergy: Stack with other defense buffs; Shield Smash's knockback keeps melee threats at distance for Intellect-based duelist builds.

forceful conversion|theurgy.synergy: Permanent charm on roll total ≤0 pairs with bane-stacking debuffers to neutralize key enemies without killing them.

forceful rebuke|protection.synergy: Blasts adjacent enemies prone and away, breaking engagements and setting up allied follow-up attacks against prone targets.

forceful summons|order.synergy: Locks a high-value target out of combat for 1 hour (immobilized+impaired); exploit while enemies try to resist.

forest of spikes|conjuration.synergy: Immobilizes enemies on cast and creates a 1-minute hazard zone; ranged builds attack pinned targets freely without entering the spikes.

forest walk|nature.synergy: Skirmishers attack then teleport to a distant plant, making them nearly impossible to pin down in forest terrain.

foretell|divination.synergy: 3 boons on all rolls for one ally near-guarantees success; best on a martial striker with attack-dependent special abilities.

forked lightning|storm.synergy: Cast inside Sleet's zone to stack Sleet's boon with the built-in metal boon, maximizing damage against armored clusters.

form of the oak guardian|nature.synergy: Stockpile low-rank Nature castings to extend duration via triggered action each turn, keeping tree form across many rounds while burning weaker spells.

fount of life|life.synergy: Cast before any healing spell; amplifies every heal in the aura by Power, so scales strongly with high-Power healer builds.

fragility|destruction.synergy: Double-damage condition on failed Strength; cast before heavy nukes to double damage output on all affected targets.

freeze|water.synergy: Immobilize lets melee allies attack the same target with boons that round; reliable action-denial at rank 0.

freezing fog|storm.synergy: Locks down a chokepoint with difficult terrain and slow; ranged attackers fire safely from outside the fog.

frighten|curse.synergy: Frightened locks an enemy out of melee; 20+ also impairs, making it a strong opener for controllers.

frightful spirit|spiritualism.synergy: Drop before ally attacks to impose banes on all enemy attack and challenge rolls within 1 yard for the round; trivial cost for a rank 0 spell.

from corruption|protection.synergy: Scales harder vs. high-Corruption enemies; lock in before fighting demons or corrupted bosses for escalating boon/bane advantages.

fugue|telepathy.synergy: 1-hour impaired+slowed combo cripples a single target for an entire encounter; party attackers gain 1 boon against it and it falls prone on every failure.

fumble|fey.synergy: Triggered casting on weapon-draws hard-counters melee fighters; disarming as a reaction denies enemies their primary offense before they can act.

funeral shroud|necromancy.synergy: Boon on Necromancy attacks plus per-round insanity pressure; pairs with insanity-escalation builds to push nearby enemies mad.

fury of the heavens|air.synergy: Concentration tornado deals 8d6/round and grabs on failed saves; reposition it each round toward clustered foes while allies stay clear.

fuse|teleportation.synergy: Permanently immobilizes a key enemy until destroyed or dismembered, letting allies freely pile damage on a locked-down target.

gatecrasher|technomancy.synergy: Attaches a 4d6 auto-damage bomb to any uncarried object; ideal for breaching doors, destroying siege engines, or timed sabotage.

gateway|teleportation.synergy: Permanent two-way portal between visited locations; unlocks campaign-level fast travel once the party has scouted key sites.

gatling gun|technomancy.synergy: Funnel enemies into a line with crowd control for maximum AoE; high-Initiative builds benefit from ending fights before the weapon jams or explodes.

geyser|water.synergy: Knocks a 5-yard-radius cluster prone, enabling allies to attack prone targets with boons; follow up with area damage while enemies are grounded.

ghastly visage|forbidden.synergy: Converts an enemy into a walking fear aura that frightens its own allies; the 20+ bane synergizes with other fear-stacking Forbidden builds.

giant form|transformation.synergy: Grants Size 3 giant stats for 1 hour without stupidity; stacks with melee builds to dominate combat with increased Health, reach, and damage output.

gift of immortality|fey.synergy: Permanently grants a key ally Spell Defense and social boons; Sacrifice mode converts the slot into emergency full healing when needed most.

gird mind|telepathy.synergy: Pre-cast before encounters with fear/charm/stun sources; Sacrifice option pivots unused castings into offensive Mind Stab.

glamer|illusion.synergy: Deploy an illusory creature to bait attacks and deal psychosomatic damage each round while the caster controls real threats elsewhere.

glide|air.synergy: Hold in reserve whenever allies risk falling; pairs naturally with knockback spells or verticality-heavy terrain to nullify fall lethality.

globe of negation|protection.synergy: Shelters martial allies inside while blocking all rank-5-and-under spells; frontliners can still charge out to engage foes.

glyph of fire|rune.synergy: Mark a clustered group and layer with crowd control to keep enemies in the 2-yard radius for repeated end-of-round hits.

glyphic prison|rune.synergy: Hard-locks one enemy in place with a massive damage threat; combine with focused party fire to punish the imprisoned target before it risks escape.

god hammer|theurgy.synergy: Deals recurring 2d6 via triggered action each turn, freeing full actions for casting or other activities while maintaining consistent pressure.

god of war|battle.synergy: Peak combat transform for melee builds; aura damage and 3-boon attacks make 8-hour windows devastating but the aftereffect risks crippling your Power.

golem|alchemy.synergy: Permanent golem ally with custom behavioral rules; serves as tank, combatant, or task-executor depending on inscribed constraints.

granite soldiers|earth.synergy: Animate battlefield rocks into construct allies; combine small rocks for larger constructs when bigger sizes aren't available.

grasping growth|nature.synergy: Reliable rank-0 slow on Will vs Strength; keep the target grounded and away from fire sources to hold the 1-minute duration.

grave grasp|necromancy.synergy: Pins multiple enemies per round and stacks bonus damage on already-immobilized targets; combos with any slow or root effect to guarantee continued lockdown.

great cat form|transformation.synergy: Converts a spell-depleted caster into a melee combatant; best when slots are exhausted and raw martial output is needed.

greater cure|life.synergy: Flexible triage for mixed ailments; Insanity removal is uniquely valuable in horror-heavy campaigns where other heals fall short.

green tongue|nature.synergy: Sacrifice mechanic turns unused castings into emergency healing equal to half healing rate; plant communication provides low-cost local divination.

grenades|technomancy.synergy: Spread three independent blasts across grouped enemies to maximize multi-target coverage in a single action.

griffon form|transformation.synergy: Flying combat form with bonus HP and extra attack damage; excels in extended adventure days where sustained martial output matters.

grotesque fantasies|forbidden.synergy: 2-bane penalty on attacks vs. dazed target multiplies every ally's attack value; insanity attrition pressures failed saves.

guarded soul|soul.synergy: Triggered 4-bane imposal neutralizes dangerous single attacks; sacrifice mode converts spell slots to emergency healing on demand.

guiding spirits|spiritualism.synergy: Spirit resource bank: spend for on-demand damage, Insanity, scouting, or roll boons; Spiritual Aid's triggered action preserves action economy.

guiding sprite|fey.synergy: Roll to extend to 1 hour for sustained scouting or social facilitation; bring a quality gift for boons and near-guaranteed cooperation.

hailstorm|storm.synergy: Difficult terrain plus knockdown traps enemies in the damage zone; deafening shuts down command-based and sonic abilities.

hallowed ground|theurgy.synergy: Creates a spell-excluding sanctuary for healing or regrouping; breaks on any attack so best deployed in non-combat windows or to protect non-combatants.

hallucinations|fey.synergy: Dazes a single target nearly every time it tries to act for a full minute; ideal for locking down solo bosses while allies deal damage.

halt time|time.synergy: Freeze enemies for 1 minute then exploit the accelerated phase to grant allies extra turns with 3-boon attacks against immobilized foes.

harm|forbidden.synergy: Drops the incapacitation threshold by 5–10, letting damage dealers finish targets with significantly fewer hits.

harness magic|arcana.synergy: Banks 4-9 extra spell slots before a major encounter; lets a nuker dump high-rank spells without burning daily castings.

harvest soul|necromancy.synergy: Cast after killing a key enemy to block resurrection and bank a heal; spend the stored heal at a critical low-health moment later.

hateful defecation|forbidden.synergy: Instant-kill on Health≤10 finishes wounded foes; secondary Will AoE impairs nearby creatures as a bonus.

heal all|life.synergy: Mass full heal after prolonged attrition; the self-risk aftereffect makes it a calculated reset button rather than a routine tool.

heal soul|life.synergy: Removes Corruption (rare utility); sacrifice mode nukes spirits for 10d6 and banishes them, making it an anti-spirit finisher.

heal the land|nature.synergy: Campaign-level ritual that removes Void corruption and restores terrain; no combat synergy, but unlocks safe zones or narrative progression.

healing berries|nature.synergy: Pre-stocks multiple party members with pocket healing that covers the full adventuring day without spending any in-combat actions.

heart of winter|storm.synergy: Shuts down a 10-mile region for days; combine with cold-immune allies or a scorched-earth retreat to deny enemy operations.

heat wave|air.synergy: Fatigued condition forces banes on attack rolls across a group; softens multiple enemies at once before a sustained fight.

heavenly choir|song.synergy: Fight-defining rank-8 aura; the +2-boon attack buff maximizes allied burst damage while simultaneously locking enemies into fear/charm cycles.

heavenly host|theurgy.synergy: Position angels at chokepoints to lock down the battlefield; 4-bane insanity aftereffect demands Will investment or insanity mitigation on the caster.

helping hand|arcana.synergy: Safely triggers traps or fetches items without exposing the caster; pairs with stealth builds needing remote object interaction.

herald of the demon lord|demonology.synergy: Capstone summoner ritual; failure nukes everything in 1 mile, so minimizing Corruption before casting and banking Will is essential for survivability.

hero spirit|spiritualism.synergy: Turns any martial ally into a 3-boon, +2 Defense, +20 HP powerhouse for 1 hour; stack with other boon sources to near-guarantee critical hits.

hex|curse.synergy: Impaired status plus 1 boon on your attacks stacks for alpha-strike builds; apply before a multiattack or high-damage follow-up.

hidden space|teleportation.synergy: Seal a powerful enemy inside and close the portal; when the spell ends they either enter the Void or take half-Health damage and land prone nearby.

hide from animals|primal.synergy: Lets Primal casters reposition safely in animal-heavy wilderness encounters without wasting attack actions.

hide from undead|necromancy.synergy: Lets any character safely traverse undead-heavy zones; ends on attack, so best used for infiltration or escape rather than active combat.

hoary tentacle|madness.synergy: Persistent grab locks one enemy per round, granting melee allies boons; Insanity aura softens casters for follow-up Madness spells.

hobble|curse.synergy: Slowed hard-counters mobile melee; 20+ prone+slowed combo pins a target for allies to exploit with ranged or area attacks.

hole of glory|teleportation.synergy: Portals bypass walls for ranged attacks, spell delivery, or object transfer; creative positioning can redirect projectiles or expose flanked enemies.

holy armaments|theurgy.synergy: Lets Will-primary casters deal 2d6+2 melee damage using Will; 2d6 bonus damage against undead/demons makes this exceptional in campaigns featuring those enemies.

holy ground|theurgy.synergy: Forces supernatural enemies to absorb massive damage just to approach while granting religious allies +15 Health, +2 Defense, and 3 boons on attacks.

hook the soul|forbidden.synergy: Kills via insanity overflow to spawn a hostile shadow servant, or chains survivors within 20 yards and forces Corruption gain on escape.

horde of monsters|chaos.synergy: Converts a crowd of enemies into uncontrolled monsters hostile to all non-monsters, redirecting enemy action economy against itself.

horrid growths|alteration.synergy: Per-round Strength challenge pressure snowballs; control spells that prevent fleeing maximize total DoT and explosion payoff.

horrid joining|forbidden.synergy: If both attacks succeed, permanently merges two creatures sharing turns (one fast, one slow), halving their combined action economy.

horrifying spirits|spiritualism.synergy: Area denial zone that damages and induces fear; forced fleeing movement opens targets to opportunity attacks from flanking melee.

host of spirits|spiritualism.synergy: Stock spirits before combat; spend them reactively to negate attack rolls, self-heal at the incapacitation threshold, or offensively frighten and damage enemies.

house of healing|life.synergy: Post-encounter ritual restoring full HP, curing all afflictions, and regrowing limbs; defines the Life tradition's camp-phase dominance.

hover|telekinesis.synergy: Triggered repositioning on enemy misses lets melee builds stay mobile without free-attack risk; flying also bypasses ground hazards.

hulk|transformation.synergy: +40 HP and 2d6 extra weapon damage peak melee tanks; fear on each attack passively controls adjacent enemies.

hurricane|storm.synergy: Shuts down all ranged combat and forces Strength checks on every creature per round; aftereffect self-risk limits use to legendary builds willing to gamble.

hymn of rebirth|song.synergy: Primary resurrection spell; Hell-soul risk of hostile furies makes target's Corruption score a critical pre-cast consideration.

ice blast|water.synergy: Cone AoE that damages and creates difficult terrain; lead with this to slow enemies before applying harder control or melee pressure.

icicle|water.synergy: Will-based casters' reliable ranged cantrip; 20+ roll triggers bonus cold damage, pairing with talents that enhance critical-hit or elemental effects.

ignite|fire.synergy: Apply persistent fire to multiple targets; synergizes with other Fire spells that benefit from targets already burning.

illumination|celestial.synergy: Marks enemies with persistent light on successful attacks, stripping concealment and aiding party visibility in darkness.

illusory double|illusion.synergy: Cast spells from the double's position while staying safe, then swap with it on any incoming hit to redirect damage to the illusion.

illusory landscape|illusion.synergy: Sacrifice ability recovers up to rank 8 in Illusion castings; functions as a resource engine for Illusion-heavy builds across extended adventuring days.

imagine a hidden kingdom|fey.synergy: Build a permanent extradimensional base over multiple Sacrifice expansions; cast while other spell slots remain to survive the brutal aftereffect window.

immolate|fire.synergy: Catch-fire adds 1d6/round ongoing; pair with effects that hinder extinguishing or push enemies away from water.

impervious|metal.synergy: Half weapon damage plus weapon destruction counters physical attackers completely; best on unarmed builds to leverage the bonus strike damage.

implant suggestion|enchantment.synergy: The concentration stun alone wins rounds; finishing the minute plants a delayed compulsion, enabling social manipulation or enemy asset subversion.

implode|telekinesis.synergy: Auto-success against targets with ≤50 max Health covers most non-boss rank-appropriate enemies; reliable elimination without needing to roll.

impregnable rune|rune.synergy: Anchor the rune in a defended position; inside the 10-yard zone objects can't be damaged and enemies can't teleport in.

imprisoned by flawless logic|order.synergy: Ends encounters by removing a powerful enemy from play for over a year; sacrifice recovers high-rank Order slots.

imprison|protection.synergy: Concentrating for a full minute permanently banishes one enemy underground with no save; escalating banes make escape near-impossible.

improvised casting|illusion.synergy: Fills situational gaps by reaching any tradition's rank-5-or-lower spell at half potency; best for rare effects your tradition lacks.

incandescent bomb|technomancy.synergy: Craft ahead of time for flexible burst deployment; blinding on failure lets allies follow up with boons against blinded targets.

incarnate nature|nature.synergy: Compelled incarnation dominates the battlefield; high-Will builds reduce aftereffect risk of permanent tree transformation.

inevitable blade|arcana.synergy: Lets Intellect casters attack vs Agility in melee and deal half damage even on misses, enabling a reliable melee-caster hybrid playstyle.

infectious groove|song.synergy: Reposition one enemy per turn into hazards or away from allies; pairs with area spells placed at the forced destination.

inhume|death.synergy: Buries multiple targets simultaneously; buried enemies spend actions digging free while taking 1d6/round, letting allies focus undivided fire.

intellectual defense|telepathy.synergy: Forces all attacks to contest your Intellect instead of lower stats; lets high-Intellect casters weaponize their primary stat defensively for 1 hour.

into the void|demonology.synergy: Permanent single-target removal; use against high-value targets where the 8d6 self-damage is worth guaranteed elimination.

introspective trance|soul.synergy: Full HP restore plus affliction cleanse without spending a rest; requires a safe 1-minute window due to defenseless+immobilized status.

investiture of the messenger|invocation.synergy: +4 Speed dramatically extends engagement range and retreat options; manage the Insanity risk with Will-focused builds.

invigorate|life.synergy: Full damage heal + 2 boons on all rolls for 1 hour; cast on a frontliner before a major fight or to restore a bloodied ally mid-combat.

invincible panoply|metal.synergy: Defense 25 makes a frontliner nearly unhittable; pair with a multi-attack warrior to maximize bonus unarmed damage output over the duration.

invisibility|illusion.synergy: Lets a scout or striker approach undetected; pairs with abilities that trigger bonuses on attacking from hiding.

invisible sun|celestial.synergy: Pre-stack fatigue on enemies via other sources to trigger extra 3d6 each round; slowed keeps targets pinned inside the area.

invulnerability|protection.synergy: Make one creature unkillable for up to a minute; ideal to protect a key ally through a boss attack surge or to hold a chokepoint.

iridescent shield|chaos.synergy: Front-liners benefit most; the degrading shield is strongest when the caster expects a short burst of incoming attacks.

iron boots|technomancy.synergy: Movement-focused build uses the free jump to reposition without costing Speed, then uses the kick to slam enemies into walls.

iron bulwark|metal.synergy: Permanently splits the battlefield or seals a chokepoint; pair with ranged allies posted behind the wall to exploit indefinite terrain advantage.

iron cage|conjuration.synergy: Remove a key enemy or group from the fight for up to 1 hour, letting your team focus the remaining targets.

iron cloud|metal.synergy: Blindness forces all affected enemies to fight at a severe disadvantage; faeries also take 3d6 damage, making this a hard counter to that creature type.

iron grasp|battle.synergy: Locks down a priority target with grab and deals automatic 1d6/round; allies gain positional advantage against grabbed foes.

iron guardian|metal.synergy: Pre-combat summon for an 8-hour iron guardian; the Health-penalty aftereffect favors high-HP tanks or builds with a guaranteed rest before the next fight.

iron to wood|fey.synergy: Strips all iron weapons to half damage for 24 hours; the sacrifice teleport converts a defensive utility slot into emergency repositioning.

jolt|storm.synergy: Prone plus knockback enables follow-up melee allies to gain attack boons; 1 boon vs. metal armor rewards targeting heavily armored foes.

jury-rig|technomancy.synergy: Rank-0 touch heal for Technomancy dips; cheap reliable healing that does not cost a casting slot.

keening|necromancy.synergy: High burst AoE with insanity and deafen; use after a debuff that imposes banes on Strength rolls to maximize failed saves.

kill them all|death.synergy: Ultimate area nuke; coordinate with allies to stay outside the 5-mile radius before casting.

killing urge|battle.synergy: Grants an ally a free triggered-action attack with a boon and bonus damage; Sacrifice lets an Intellect caster contribute melee damage directly.

kindred soul|illusion.synergy: Enables infiltration of any ancestry's community and universal language comprehension; core pre-encounter buff for face builds operating in unfamiliar cultures.

lasting image|illusion.synergy: Sets up persistent visual/auditory decoys for infiltration or misdirection lasting 24 hours; repeated casting can make the effect permanent.

laughing scoundrel|invocation.synergy: Stacks 1 Insanity per round on all nearby enemies while immunizing the caster, accelerating madness on low-Will opponents over multiple rounds.

lay bare the cosmic mysteries|madness.synergy: Sacrifice lets you convert a casting into Worms from the Ninth Dimension; dual-purpose investment for Madness casters who want information then nuking.

leaf on the wind|soul.synergy: Sacrifice mode allows free repositioning without provoking free attacks, enabling hit-and-run loops each turn for skirmishers.

leaping lightning|storm.synergy: Chain-hits clustered or metal-armored foes with diminishing dice; peak value against 4+ targets, gaining 1 boon per metal wearer.

legendary beast|primal.synergy: Supercharges a summoned beast or self under beast within to deal massive damage and knock down smaller creatures.

legerdemain|arcana.synergy: Minor object manipulation for social and exploration contexts; no combat value but supports face and infiltration playstyles.

lick your wounds|primal.synergy: Free between-encounter self-heal at rank 0; 1-hour disease/poison resistance synergizes with dungeon and wilderness hazards.

life sense|life.synergy: Lets you track hidden living enemies and nullify stealth within a 5-yard bubble, setting up targeted attacks or blocking ambushes.

life siphon|death.synergy: Mutual immobilization favors melee casters; stack multiple targets to maximize cumulative Health gain each concentration round.

life surge|life.synergy: Pre-combat cast on a striker grants boon on all attacks and challenge rolls plus trickle healing for the full minute.

light healing|life.synergy: Baseline filler for Life healers; efficient at rank 1 for keeping allies topped off between major combats.

lightning bolt|storm.synergy: Angle along a corridor wall to rebound the bolt, double-dipping creatures in the overlap zone for two Agility saves worth of damage.

lightning storm|storm.synergy: Stuns metal-armored targets for up to 1 minute, leaving them prone and defenseless for follow-up attacks with boons.

light|celestial.synergy: Provides hour-long illumination at rank 0; negligible build cost makes it a free filler pick for any Celestial caster.

lion spirit|spiritualism.synergy: Buff a charging melee ally to trigger a free extra weapon attack each charge while also boosting damage, speed, and durability.

living inferno|fire.synergy: Adds 1d6 to every Fire spell you cast while taxing melee attackers; stack with Fireball or Rain of Fire for amplified damage rounds.

loathing|enchantment.synergy: Redirects primary target's attacks toward a chosen secondary, acting as behavioral control with an impaired debuff.

locate|divination.synergy: Reveals path to a target and negates its ability to hide for 1 hour; chain with mobility spells to run down fleeing enemies.

logic prison|order.synergy: On a successful Will attack, hard-locks a priority target out of the fight for up to a minute; ideal for neutralizing a boss while allies engage minions.

lords and ladies|fey.synergy: Summons up to 18 elves if you socially retain them; the extreme-range sacrifice teleport is among the best escape tools in the tradition.

lure|enchantment.synergy: Funnel enemies into a hazard zone or chokepoint; the 3-bane penalty collapses their offense while they are compelled to converge.

mad laughter|curse.synergy: Dazes a target for 1 minute and stacks Insanity; combos with Insanity-accumulation builds or any controller needing 1-minute action denial.

mad piping of the outer dark|madness.synergy: Stack insanity beforehand to maximize fear triggers; frightened creatures become dazed puppets you redirect, locking them out of actions.

maddening drone|song.synergy: Pairs with melee allies who benefit from the boon on attack rolls while the caster spends each action concentrating.

magic acorns|nature.synergy: Rank 0 control at range; incapacitated targets permanently root as saplings, hard-removing weak enemies from combat with no save on the transformation.

magic dart|arcana.synergy: Reliable auto-hit fallback for blasters; no attack roll needed makes it consistent for finishing low-Health targets.

magic item|technomancy.synergy: Weapon-enchanting buff pairs with martials for +1d6 damage and attack boons; ritual investment makes it permanent.

magic lock|protection.synergy: Seals escape routes or secures loot; controllers use it to funnel enemies into a bottleneck without spending action economy on guards.

magic trap|protection.synergy: Designate allies as immune then guard a chokepoint; first enemy approach triggers a full 6d6 burst that you survive safely.

magic wrench|technomancy.synergy: Prone from a rank-0 spell grants melee allies attack boons on follow-up; strong Intellect build opener with no resource cost beyond a casting.

magical vortex|arcana.synergy: Strips existing buffs on entry and suppresses casting nearby; move it to chase fleeing casters or hold a chokepoint.

maim|destruction.synergy: Fear proc on nearby friendlies of the target disrupts group action economy; most effective against clustered, coordinated enemies.

major earthquake|earth.synergy: Scales Earthquake to 1d6 minutes and 4d6 structural damage per round; collapses buildings to bury clustered enemies or destroy fortifications.

major healing|life.synergy: Three-times healing rate in one touch; best on frontline tanks who took heavy hits and need fast, deep recovery.

major paradox|time.synergy: Removes multiple enemies from the fight for 1 minute with no ongoing saves; gives your party free rounds to eliminate remaining threats.

malefic monstrosities|alteration.synergy: Permanently removes enemies from combat; pair with control spells to prevent targets from taking damage and breaking the stun.

malform|alteration.synergy: Impaired + frightening softens a key target for the whole party; follow up with area control while the debuffed enemy struggles to act.

malleability|alteration.synergy: Eliminates all movement restrictions for a melee combatant, enabling perfect positioning regardless of terrain or grapples.

manikins|alchemy.synergy: Scout via construct perception-sharing, then sacrifice for on-demand AoE burst; dual-role summon for intelligence-gathering and combat.

manipulate flame|fire.synergy: The fire-damage sacrifice is the main draw—halving incoming fire damage as a reaction justifies the slot; the flame-manipulation effects are creative utility.

mantle of holiness|theurgy.synergy: Offensively grants attack boons while defensively imposing banes on undead/demon attacks; early-end healing adds battlefield flexibility.

mantle of thanatos|death.synergy: Punishes melee attackers passively; pair with high-armor builds to bait additional melee attacks and maximize retaliation procs.

mark of the beast|demonology.synergy: Forces random attacks for 1 minute, turning an enemy against its own allies; pairs with Insanity-stacking builds for a madness spiral.

mask|transformation.synergy: Essential for face characters doing infiltration; lasts an hour which covers most social encounters and short investigations.

mass concealment|illusion.synergy: Making the whole party invisible for up to 1 hour enables simultaneous sneak attacks and makes all targets nearly untargetable.

mass flight|air.synergy: Grants the whole party fly + Speed+2 for 1 hour, enabling aerial flanking and bypassing ground-based threats entirely.

mass healing|life.synergy: Concentrates output on 1-2 allies (3× healing rate) for emergency recovery or spreads across the full party at 1× healing rate for triage.

memory of the forge|metal.synergy: Targets carried weapons/armor to deal automatic 1d6 per round and coerce melee enemies into dropping their gear or risking catching fire.

mend|technomancy.synergy: Restores full health to a touched target; invaluable for repairing construct allies created by Powered Suit mid-combat.

mental armor|telekinesis.synergy: Second health pool matching your own Health; expend low-rank Telekinesis spells as triggered actions to repair it without losing your main action.

mental feast|madness.synergy: One cast neutralizes key enemies for days; compelled foes act against allies while Strength drains to 0.

mental stability|order.synergy: Blanket protection against mind-control and fear in a single cast; lets the party engage illusion/order-heavy enemies without losing key combatants.

meteoric assault|battle.synergy: High-Speed builds thread corridors to chain hits on multiple enemies; extra damage scales with each target hit past the first.

meteor|fire.synergy: Hits everything in a 1-yard sphere with no attack roll; ideal opener in tight formations or doorways.

mighty attack|battle.synergy: Adds 2d6 damage with a boon to attack; pairs with other on-hit damage riders to maximize single-target burst.

mighty fortress|conjuration.synergy: Faceless servants scale with occupants, creating a self-sustaining base; permanence option enables a permanent stronghold at severe repeated personal cost.

true protection|protection.synergy: Apply once before the adventure; the aftereffect risk is front-loaded while the target gains near-immortality for a month.

truth ear|divination.synergy: Enables lie detection during interrogation or negotiation; face characters gain decisive social edge for 1 hour.

tsunami|water.synergy: Rank-10 finisher; casters need flight or Teleportation to escape the 10d6 Strength aftereffect — pair with mobility spells.

tumescent puffballs|nature.synergy: Cluster puffballs in choke points to detonate on enemy approach; poison stacks with existing poison sources and the obscurement cuts line of sight.

twain self|time.synergy: Doubles all offensive output for 1 minute at the cost of 1 bane on rolls; any build with high base attack or spell potency benefits enormously.

twisted crown|fey.synergy: Stuns all nearby creatures each turn you concentrate; anchor near clustered enemies to repeatedly deny actions with no extra action cost beyond concentration.

twisted words|curse.synergy: Force an NPC to expose truths by compelling lies; 20+ roll removes concentration and locks the curse for a full minute.

ultimate security|protection.synergy: Converts a held structure into a multi-layered death trap with auto-spawned guardians; best used during downtime to defend a base.

unassailable mind|telepathy.synergy: Shuts down all mental attack builds for 1 minute; exploit the window by pressing aggressive positioning.

unchained probabilities|chaos.synergy: Pre-stack boons on allies before casting; on even d6 turns allies roll three d20s and keep the highest, dramatically raising hit rates.

undead legion|necromancy.synergy: Fields hundreds of undead as a single compelled unit; Sacrifice fully heals you and all undead, making it a panic-button reset.

undead plague|necromancy.synergy: Seals off a 10-mile zone and turns every death into a friendly undead or spirit; drop over a contested battlefield to generate an ever-growing autonomous army.

underwater adaptation|alteration.synergy: Enables full combat effectiveness underwater; pairs with Water tradition spells or aquatic encounter preparation for any melee build.

underworld screams|death.synergy: Place on a choke point; every hit dealt inside the zone adds 2d6, so AoE or multi-hit allies multiply total output for 1 minute.

underworld|spiritualism.synergy: Center Spiritualism buff zone here—2 boons on attacks and banes on resists—while the zone drains, frightens, and traps approaching foes.

underworld’s gates|spiritualism.synergy: Sustained portal forces ongoing Will vs Insanity while producing random Underworld creatures that threaten all combatants each minute.

undo constitution|death.synergy: Weakened target takes double damage from disease and poison while making all Strength rolls with 2 banes, enabling a poison/disease combo-dealer.

undo reality|chaos.synergy: Caster risks taking damage equal to full Health on failure; pair with damage-reduction effects or high Health to survive the self-destruction roll.

unerring darts|arcana.synergy: Auto-hit bypasses concealment and attack-roll penalties; split 7 darts across low-HP minions or concentrate on a hard-to-hit target.

unfailing tracker|technomancy.synergy: Prevents the target from hiding for 1 hour; combos with any ability that requires exact location or punishes non-hidden foes.

unhinge the mind|telepathy.synergy: Dumps Insanity equal to target's Will score in one hit; devastating against high-Will casters, likely triggering immediate fear or madness.

unholy chorus|demonology.synergy: Cluster enemies tightly before casting; each stunned singer spreads insanity to adjacent foes each round.

universal solvent|alchemy.synergy: Pre-crafted single-use weapon that dissolves incapacitated targets outright or deals massive splash damage when thrown.

unleash bone machine|necromancy.synergy: Creates a powerful undead construct; Sacrifice option mass-heals all compelled undead within medium range as a single action.

unlife|death.synergy: Death attack casters gain 1 boon on every attack roll and enemies resist with 1 bane for 4 hours, effectively raising all Death spell accuracy.

unlight|madness.synergy: Grants chosen allies true sight vs invisibility and illusions for 1 hour; critical-failure Insanity risk punishes enemies who roll poorly in the area.

unlikely transformation|chaos.synergy: Impaired+frightened combo shuts down the primary target while spreading AoE fear; high-Will casters fishing for 20+ can chain into full polymorph.

unlock potential|alteration.synergy: Cast as triggered action before a key ally's roll to grant 1 boon for free; full 2-boon version rewards turns with no other spell to cast.

unmake|death.synergy: Auto-succeeds on targets at 50 or less Health; soften targets first then use as a finisher to dodge the lethal aftereffect.

unreasoning hatred|enchantment.synergy: Force a dangerous enemy to fixate on a tank with 3-bane attacks on allies; redirect with triggered action each round.

unruly organs|forbidden.synergy: Incapacitation spawns hostile tiny monsters as a chaos payoff; baned Strength saves sustain pressure even on strong targets.

unspeakable graft|forbidden.synergy: Permanently grafts creature traits (claws, darkvision) onto allies; Corruption and Insanity costs gate it to high-value upgrades only.

untouchable object|protection.synergy: Protects a spell focus, potion, or critical gear from theft or disarm attempts for a full hour during exploration.

uplifting melody|song.synergy: Rotate 2-boon benefit to the party's primary attacker each round or save it for a critical challenge roll; stacks with other boon sources on the same roll.

uplifting step|air.synergy: Lets melee builds bypass difficult terrain and environmental gaps to stay on top of kiting targets or reach backline enemies.

utter ruin|forbidden.synergy: Pre-apply blindness with another spell, then cast this to remove it and trigger the full insanity+potential self-harm chain.

vacuum|air.synergy: Clusters and knocks prone multiple enemies across a wide area; follow-up area spells benefit greatly from prone targets.

venomous dart|alchemy.synergy: Pre-combat setup that arms up to 5 allies with attack-boon darts that poison on hit; pairs with poison-stacking builds.

venomous fangs|primal.synergy: Opens the poisoned condition for skirmishers; deals escalating damage to already-poisoned targets for duelist combos.

venomous shape|transformation.synergy: Pairs with Animal Shape to add poison melee in animal form; sacrifice clause enables Flowing Form for action economy.

vertigo|illusion.synergy: Caps enemy movement at 2 yards and punishes any movement with prone, enabling melee allies who gain boons attacking prone targets.

vexing spirit|spiritualism.synergy: Frightened target gets repositioned on every failed roll; pairs with terrain hazards or melee allies to punish each failure.

vigilance|protection.synergy: Pre-combat buff protecting a frontliner from charm/fear/surprise; the Perception boon also guards against ambushes.

vigor|protection.synergy: Pre-combat health padding that lets healers stretch their resources; stacks with healing spells to keep frontliners standing longer.

vision of nowhere|demonology.synergy: Soul-destruction on madness makes it a kill-finisher against targets already carrying high Insanity.

vision|divination.synergy: Hard-counters invisibility, illusions, and darkness for a full hour; enables targeting hidden enemies and see-through-walls scouting.

vision’s end|forbidden.synergy: Three failed Strength rolls make blindness permanent, crippling any melee or ranged combatant for the rest of the fight.

vitality burst|life.synergy: Restores the whole party in a single cast; most efficient when three or more allies each need a healing rate's worth of damage cleared.

vivisection|forbidden.synergy: Insta-kill on incapacitation plus forced Insanity on all witnesses makes it a morale-breaker against humanoid groups.

voice of thunder|song.synergy: Prone + push denies enemy stand actions and repositions them; pairs with difficult terrain or hazards to punish the forced movement.

voice of ultimate authority|order.synergy: Auto-compels Will ≤15 targets without a roll; use Will attacks on stronger foes for 1-hour compelled status across a long rest.

void tentacles|shadow.synergy: Grabs up to 5 creatures per activation; already-grabbed targets auto-fail future rolls and risk lethal damage plus permanent void elimination.

voracious earth|earth.synergy: Repeated auto-damage at end of each round; lock enemies in place with immobilize effects to guarantee full exposure.

vulnerability|curse.synergy: Cast before a nova round so all allies attack with 1 boon and the target resists every effect with 1 bane.

waking nightmare|illusion.synergy: Stacks Insanity each round; combine with other Insanity sources to trigger madness-death before the target accumulates enough banes to shut down the nightmare.

wall of darkness|shadow.synergy: Shadow-tradition allies with darksight fight freely inside while blinded enemies are pinned; combine with Shadow Snakes for layered zone denial.

wall of flames|fire.synergy: Forces enemies to route around or eat 3d6/round; synergizes with push or pull effects that drag creatures through it.

wall of gears|technomancy.synergy: Splits the battlefield for 1 hour, dealing up to 6d6 initial plus 3d6/round to any creature passing through; zone denial paired with forced movement effects.

wall of ice|water.synergy: Wall immobilizes on save failure and deals cold damage each round for an hour; ideal for ranged or blaster builds that punish locked-down targets.

wall of runes|rune.synergy: Bisects a battlefield to immobilize enemies and impose difficult terrain; 1-hour duration makes it effective for dungeon chokepoints.

wall of stone|earth.synergy: Permanently seals routes or creates bridges; funnels enemies into choke points for area spells or melee.

wall of swords|battle.synergy: Zone-denial wall blocks line of sight and punishes entry with recurring damage; funnels enemies into a prepared kill zone.

warden of the underworld|death.synergy: Place at chokepoints; triggered attacks punish approach and the initial fear effect disrupts enemy positioning.

warding buckler|metal.synergy: Reserve the triggered cast for 3 banes on a critical incoming hit; the passive form gives sustained defense.

warp flesh|alteration.synergy: Cheap touch-damage opener with conditional impaired bonus on a 20+ Will attack; pairs with Will-focused melee or grapple builds.

watchful eyes|technomancy.synergy: Deployed pre-combat for alarm and area denial; deafen effect disrupts spellcasters and enables ambushes.

water burst|water.synergy: AoE damage with prone knockdown enables melee allies to exploit prone enemies; knockback displaces grouped foes.

watery form|water.synergy: Half damage from all sources plus 1d6 Water spell damage bonus; best for aquatic Water blasters needing survivability.

watery serpent|water.synergy: Persistent serpent restricts movement on hit each round; triggered-action attacks pair with builds that have extra triggered actions.

wave|water.synergy: Wall grants half cover for 1 round then auto-knocks a wide zone prone; melee allies attacking prone targets gain boons.

weakness|curse.synergy: Strips 10 Health and imposes banes on Strength/Agility rolls; permanent on 20+, ideal for debuffing boss monsters.

weapon appendage|transformation.synergy: Lets Will-based casters attack in melee; cast-and-strike action compression with crit bonus rewards aggressive duelist builds.

wee free men|fey.synergy: Forced repositioning each round shoves enemies into hazards or away from allies; impair stacks with other debuffs for compounding action denial.

weight of years|death.synergy: Aging 3 categories deals near-lethal damage on a Strength failure; maximizes output against low-Strength high-Health targets.

well of dark power|necromancy.synergy: Drop before a burst round; every hit on any creature in the zone adds +2d6, multiplying output for high-attack-count allies or multi-hit spells.

well of magic|arcana.synergy: Positions your party in a zone where attack spells gain 2 boons and targets suffer 2 banes to resist; devastating with blasters.

wellspring of life|water.synergy: Cast before burst healing to add +1d3 per heal to every creature in the zone; multiplies group restoration significantly.

whirlwind of death|battle.synergy: Double-sweep plus repositioning fly is maximized opening centrally among dense enemies, trading a fatigue risk for massive area damage.

wild magic|chaos.synergy: Unpredictable roll-table results make this a desperation button; Chaos builds treat the variance as a feature rather than a drawback.

wildfire|fire.synergy: Movable 10-yard fire cube pairs with crowd-control to keep enemies inside for repeated 5d6 hits each round.

will-o’-wisp|fey.synergy: Herd beguiled enemies into hazards or AoE kill zones each round by repositioning the flame; concentration investment scales with number of beguiled targets.

wind blast|air.synergy: Knockback plus prone on a crit; push enemies off ledges, break formations, or create separation to protect fragile allies.

wind disk|air.synergy: Defense bonus plus ranged-bane aura; Shield Disk extends coverage to nearby allies, making it a versatile anchor for Will-based tanks.

wipe the mind|telepathy.synergy: Reduces Intellect and Will to 1, shutting down all spellcasting and social abilities; 24-hour version trivializes boss encounters.

witch fire|witch.synergy: Attacks from concealment each round while repositioning the ball freely; teleport on expiry enables safe disengagement or flanking.

world-breaker bomb|technomancy.synergy: Last-resort area nuke; self-risk aftereffect means build around surviving it (high Strength, healing) or accept it as a one-way button.

wrath of god|theurgy.synergy: Group enemies before casting to maximize area damage and stack the dazed condition on multiple foes simultaneously.

wrath of nature|nature.synergy: Immobilized targets grant melee boons to allies; pair with follow-up area blasts to punish locked-down clusters.

written in blood|demonology.synergy: At rank 0, imposes 2 banes on all attacks against you and 2 boons on resists; layers with armor or other defensive buffs for near-unhittable defense.

wyvern form|transformation.synergy: Highest-rank flying battle form; burn it before boss fights where creature power outpaces remaining spell options.

zeal|enchantment.synergy: Pair with protection spells to keep allies uninjured and compound the +2d6 damage bonus with high-accuracy allies for massive sustained output.
